the SLM-technology can be applied to produce high density duplex stainless steel 22.05 parts.

the SLM processing and post-processing heat treatment of duplex stainless steel.
the effect of heat treatments on the microstructure and properties of the SLS-processed material.
SLM processing of duplex stainless steel and its post-processing heat treatment to achieve the desired microstructure and properties.

the SLM process and the post-processing heat treatment can be used to produce duplex stainless steel 3D parts with high density, good mechanical properties, and improved corrosion resistance.
SLM of duplex stainless steel is feasible and that post-processing heat treatment is a viable approach to obtain the desired duplex microstructure with improved properties.
the SLM process is capable to fabricate high-density duplex stainless steel 22Cr-5Ni-3Mo-0.2N material with high corrosion resistance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

SLM of duplex stainless steel is possible, and it produces a material that is stronger than conventionally produced duplex stainless steels, and that can be tailored for a wide variety of applications.

the SLM- processed duplex stainless steel 22Cr-5Ni-3Mn (2205) alloy is a promising material for AM, and that the post-processing annealing at 1050 ° C is the optimal treatment to obtain the desired dual-phase structure with high corrosion resistance.
SLM-processed 2205 duplex stainless steel can be successfully heat-treated to achieve the desired phase balance and mechanical properties.

SLM-processed duplex stainless steel 22% Cr–5% Ni (2205) is a promising material for AM applications, especially for components that require good mechanical properties and corrosion resistance.
SLM-processed 2205 is suitable for manufacturing of corrosion-resistant components with complex geometries.
